author: TEDx Talks
description:
We often hear that relationships should be “50/50,” but what does that really mean? Does it mean each person gives 50%? Or that we give 100%—but only half the time? This transactional mindset isn’t just unrealistic; it limits the depth and potential of human connection. Drawing from insights by Michelle Obama in The Light We Carry and Brené Brown’s work, I will explore why relationships should be about striving for a shared 100%—not dividing it. The reality is, life doesn’t work in perfect halves. Some days you can give 90%, while your partner can only manage 10%. Other days, it’s reversed. 

This dynamic applies not only to personal relationships but also to how we approach work and community. Consider the workplace: a big project demands 90% of my energy, while my colleagues give the remaining 10% in support. Or think about public good—how often do we give the majority of our energy to those in need, without expecting an equal return? These moments highlight the beauty of relationsh
title: Why the ‘perfectly balanced’ relationship is a myth | Katie Chaney | TEDxBGSU

 Through her experiences in art, writing, and digital media, Fathima speaks about breaking societal expectations, embracing authenticity, and amplifying diverse voices. Her talk is a call to celebrate individuality and the courage to be unapologetically oneself.

author: TEDx Talks
description:
In this TEDx talk, P. Shravan Kumar shares a personal journey of moving from an introverted student to a resilient entrepreneur—guided by one simple principle: focus on the goal, not the noise around it. Drawing inspiration from everyday life, ancient wisdom, and real-world setbacks, he explains how repeated distractions, fear of failure, and social pressure often pull people away from their true purpose.

Using powerful metaphors—from classroom behavior to stories from the Mahabharata—this talk explores why resilience is not about shortcuts or instant success, but about doing one’s duty consistently, even when results are uncertain. Shravan reflects on losing teammates, facing rejection, turning down secure opportunities, and choosing long-term impact over short-term rewards.

At its core, this talk reminds us that leadership is not built in comfort. It is shaped through persistence, clarity of purpose, and the courage to keep moving forward—especially when the path is unclear. P. Sh

author: TEDx Talks
description:
In this thought-provoking TEDx talk, Dr. Yogesh Pawar unpacks how beliefs are formed through repetition and how, over time, these beliefs quietly shape our habits, decisions, and character. Using simple everyday examples, he explains a powerful truth: what we repeatedly see, hear, and experience becomes our reality.

The talk explores the journey from exposure to belief, belief to behavior, behavior to habit, and habit to culture—showing how individuals, families, organizations, and even societies are unconsciously shaped by their environment. Dr. Pawar highlights the critical difference between beliefs (external and learned) and values (internal and lived), and why long-term success and fulfillment depend on aligning the two.

Moving beyond theory, he introduces practical leadership behaviors that foster clarity, connection, and growth—such as listening deeply, appreciating others, creating psychological safety, and choosing values-driven action over control.

This talk is a reminder
title: The Evolution of a Leader Through Failure | Dr. Yogesh Pawar | TEDxDWPS Noida Extension Youth

description:
Aisling Cannon's talk begins with a vivid moment many women will recognise: the fear of feeling unsafe at night. That experience became the spark for Walkie Talkie Girlies, a society co-founded to create a safe space for people to exercise, socialise, and get outdoors.
The talk explores how this small act of walking together quickly grew into a recognised student movement, offering not only safety in numbers but also a sense of community. It then turns to Project Pink, the flagship campaign, which saw Belfast City Hall and Queen’s University lit pink in solidarity with victims of violence against women and girls. With over 600 participants, support from local leaders, and national media coverage, the campaign demonstrated the power of grassroots activism.
Ultimately, Aisling's talk shows how collective steps, however small, can spark discussion and transform fear into hope. Aisling Cannon is currently completing an LLM in International Human Rights Law at Queen's University Belfast. O

description:
What if the reason students are walking away from music isn’t because they’ve changed—but because school music hasn’t?

Dr. Kevin Droe, music educator and founder of Amp Camp, challenges the traditions that have defined school music for over a century. In a world where young people create beats, write songs, and collaborate online, most schools still teach music as if it’s 1950. Droe envisions a future where every student—whether they love rock, hip hop, pop, or country—has a place in music class.

Through stories of transformation and belonging, he reveals how modern band programs are reigniting students’ passion for music, fostering creativity, and making music education relevant again. This talk isn’t about replacing the classics—it’s about expanding the invitation so that every child can find their voice in the soundtrack of today. Mujer Líder con reconocimiento internacional en derechos humanos, ha sido delegada ante la Unión Europea y la OTAN. Premiada con distinciones como Mujer Tec y el Premio Estatal de la Juventud. title: Apuesta por ti; vivir bajo tu propósito | María Fernanda Cámara | TEDxUPAEP

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Kayla Blanco replantea la idea de productividad constante y nos invita a entender el descanso como una decisión consciente. Comparte cómo el cansancio extremo no siempre significa fracaso, sino una señal para pausar, escucharse y visibiliza el burnout como una realidad silenciosa en la búsqueda del éxito.
 Es una joven conferencista, escritora y creadora del podcast "El-evando Mentes". Con una profunda pasión por el desarrollo per-sonal, ha hecho de su camino de aprendizaje una plataforma para inspirar a otros. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: Yo no me rendí, solo aprendí a descansar | Kayla Blanco | TEDxUPAEP

author: TEDx Talks
description:
El Dr. Polo nos comparte su experiencia como estudiante de medicina y explica por qué el mayor desafío de la carrera no son los exámenes, sino la constancia de sentarse a estudiar. A partir de la diferencia entre sacrificio y sufrimiento, propone una nueva forma de enfrentar el aprendizaje como también un método práctico basado en planeación, ejecución y evaluación.
 Dr. Carlos Guerrero, también conocido en redes como el Dr. Polo, es un médico general que por medio de las redes sociales, busca incentivar la cultura de la prevención y del diagnóstico temprano en la población en general a través de información basada en evidencia.
Es el médico con más seguidores en México y Latinoamérica, co-autor de "Pero querías ser doctor parte 2", fundador de Leomedicina, una plataforma de educación médica continua y que tiene múltiples experiencias como ponente a nivel nacional e internacional. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a loca
title: ¿Cómo mejorar en la escuela de medicina? | Polo Guerrero | TEDxUPAEP

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Rosa Laura compartió su experiencia personal al transitar de una carrera corporativa tradicional hacia una nueva vocación como creadora de contenido, y cómo la incomodidad y el estrés fueron señales de crecimiento, no de error. A partir de evidencia científica sobre estrés, propósito e incertidumbre, explicó cómo reinterpretar momentos de cambio para convertirlos en retos en lugar de amenazas.  Rosa Laura López es actuaría con un MBA por la Universidad de Columbia. Inició su carrera en venture capital en Angel Ventures y, desde entonces, ha desarrollado una trayectoria sólida en sectores como tecnología y retail. Ha formado parte de startups en etapa temprana, trabajó en Uber como parte del equipo regional de operaciones para América Latina, fundó su propia empresa de retail y recientemente lideró el lanzamiento y operación de Pickup Coffee, cadena que logró abrir 30 tiendas en su primer año en la Ciudad de México.
Además de su experiencia ejecutiva, Rosa Laura es co-host de Chisme Co
title: Me da pena decir que soy influencer | Rosa Laura López | TEDxUPAEP

author: TEDx Talks
description: This talk explores how curiosity and hands-on experimentation can lead to scientific understanding. By building a low-cost satellite signal receiver, the speaker demonstrates how complex systems emerge from simple components. The talk emphasizes learning through experimentation and observation. Mast. Saul Sarang Patil is a young tech enthusiast who discovered a powerful insight while working on a simple competition project – climate change becomes visible when we look at the data. His exploration of land surface temperature patterns revealed how global warming is shaped not by one big event, but by millions of everyday actions and how small, consistent choices can also drive meaningful change. Through his talk, he reminds us that anyone, at any age, can contribute to a healthier planet by recognizing the impact of the decisions we make daily. title: What Simple Experiments Reveal About Complex Systems | Saul Sarang Patil | TEDxSanjivani University

author: TEDx Talks
description: This talk reflects on a young writer’s journey into authorship and self-expression. It challenges the idea that innovation is limited to technology or age. The story highlights how creativity and commitment can shape meaningful work early in life. Ms. Adya Anand Kale is a 13-year-old young author whose journey into writing began with a simple spark – an idea that grew into three published books inspired by everyday moments, personal experiences, and her curiosity about the world. Drawn to creativity, storytelling, and emerging technologies, she explores themes ranging from friendship to environmental awareness to reflections from her own travels. Through her work, she highlights how listening, observing, and nurturing small ideas can lead to meaningful expression, reminding young people that passion and persistence can create opportunities far beyond age or expectation. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community
title: Passion Outruns Age  | Adya Anand Kale | TEDxSanjivani University

description: This talk shares the journey of a tribal woman who used small savings, skill training, and collective effort to build sustainable livelihoods. Despite setbacks such as the pandemic, her work strengthened families and created local employment. The story highlights how women’s self-reliance can quietly reshape communities over time. Mrs. Suma Uikey is a passionate social entrepreneur and community leader known for transforming rural livelihoods. Through her innovative work in mushroom cultivation and rural development, she has empowered families by creating sustainable income opportunities. Deeply committed to inclusive growth, she actively promotes education, skill-building, and access to essential resources for underserved communities. Her efforts continue to drive meaningful progress at the grassroots level. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: How Collective Savings Can Transform Rural Lives | Suma Uikey | TEDxSanjivani University

description: This talk explores the evolution of AI from prediction to imagination. Using real-world research examples, it shows how machines can augment human creativity rather than replace it. The focus is on collaboration between human insight and computational intelligence. Dr. Nikhil Malhotra is a global innovation leader whose work spans AI, world models, quantum computing, neuroscience-inspired architectures, and responsible technology development. As the founder of Makers Lab, he has led deep-tech research efforts ranging from India’s first Indic LLM, Project Indus, to enterprise agentic systems such as TechM Orion. His contributions include developing multimodal diagnostic AI for healthcare, advancing world-model–based frameworks for autonomous decision-making, exploring synthetic imagination through Dream.AI, and driving quantum readiness and security programs. title: When Artificial Intelligence Becomes a Creative Partner | Nikhil Malhotra | TEDxSanjivani University

author: TEDx Talks
description:
In this introspective, science-rooted TEDx talk, Nadeem reflects on boredom not as absence, but as an invitation. In moments of silence, something shifts. Curiosity stirs. Patterns begin to surface.
Moving between personal experience and quiet insight, the talk explores what happens when we stop filling every gap and start listening instead. How stillness can spark creativity. How reflection can lead us closer to purpose without announcing it loudly.
This is a pause in a restless world.
A space to wonder.
A reminder that what we’re searching for may already be waiting in the quiet. A mechanical engineer by education, he transitioned into content creation and built it into a profitable startup. He began his career as an automation testing engineer during Covid but soon realized the field did not align with his passion. title: How Boredom Helps You Find Your Purpose in Life | Mohammad Nadeem | TEDxMJCET

author: TEDx Talks
description:
What does freedom look like in the age of innovation?
In this compelling talk, Suneet explores how patents and intellectual property shape economic independence in the modern world. Drawing striking parallels between India’s freedom struggle and today’s global race for innovation, he reframes patents not as legal tools, but as instruments of long-term national power.
Suneet challenges entrepreneurs, universities, and policymakers to rethink how ideas are protected, valued, and owned. His talk is a call to build global intellectual property leadership and to reclaim innovation as a form of modern freedom.
 Suneet B Sabale, a mechanical engineer turned intellectual property expert, is the founder of Brainiac IP Solutions, a leading IP consultancy. A registered Indian Patent Agent and two-time IAM300 Global IP Strategist, he helps innovators protect, scale, and monetize their ideas globally. An inventor with a granted patent and former Court Commissioner in patent cases, Suneet has also
title: Back to Basics: Innovation, Patents, and India’s Fight for Freedom | Suneet B Sabale | TEDxMJCET

author: TEDx Talks
description: This TEDx talk explores how individuals can thrive in the emerging “white space” of the Fourth Industrial Revolution by embracing technology as a partner in personal learning and development. It presents tech in three roles: a change expert that helps us adapt to evolving fields and reduce fear of the unknown, a cheerleader that boosts intrinsic motivation by supporting autonomy, mastery, and purpose, and a coach that guides us in building behavioural, functional, and technical skills. The talk ends with a call to action, urging listeners to intentionally engage with technology in three ways—researching innovations, reflecting on personal interests, and taking a course to build a skill—so they can harness curiosity, gain confidence, and shape their own future. Celina Mattocks is a tech leader and founder/CEO of Lead Live Learn, a professional development firm leveraging emerging tech for skills growth. title: How Emerging Technology Increases Confidence & Self-Worth | Celina Mattocks | TEDxMontgomery College

description: This talk traces how a small act of mentorship grew into a community-based learning initiative. It highlights the gap between talent and opportunity and shows how education and care can unlock potential in underserved communities. Mr. Gulati is a renowned social entrepreneur and the co-founder of Manzil, a pioneering nonprofit organization dedicated to fostering learning, skill development, and empowerment among youth. With decades of experience in community development and educational innovation, he has played an instrumental role in creating opportunities for young individuals to discover their potential and contribute meaningfully to society. His work reflects a deep commitment to experiential learning, inclusive growth, and sustainable social impact. Through his thoughtful leadership and community-centered initiatives, Mr. Gulati has become an influential voice in shaping alternative education models in India.
